figures.caption: Figure 2. a) Room temperature conductivity and b) activation energy for LPSCl and LPSCl1.5 electrolytes annealed at different temperatures (300–550 °C). c) Nyquist plots and d) Arrhenius plots of LPSCl1.5 electrolyte annealed at different temperatures (300 –550 °C). The black dotted lines and red arrows indicate intra-cage and inter-cage pathways, respectively. Li-ion probability densities for f) LPSCl and g) LPSCl1.5 obtained from AIMD simulations at 900 K.
